title: Source
description: One concrete data source that renditions and asset bindings refer to, such as a DataLad dataset. Its identity (source_type, source_id) never changes; the places it can be had from (urls, paths) are united as it travels. Where it is on a given machine (a local clone) is that machine's business: see kb source show.

source_type.description: The kind of source (kb source types lists them).

source_id.description: The source's own global identity: for DataLad, the dataset ID (a UUID), or git:<first commit> for a dataset without one; for a filesystem, its root name (as in filesystems.NAME and fs bindings).

urls.description: Where it can be cloned or fetched from (for DataLad: anything datalad clone accepts: https, ssh, ria+...).

paths.description: Local file trees holding it, by host (a shared filesystem path is usable by everyone on that host).
